summary: Rail Vision Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the launch of YardFlow, an AI perception solution for industrial and freight railyard operations. No securities transaction, stake, price per share, premium, or closing date is stated. The release notes YardFlow will support the company's commercial collaboration with Railserve, a Marmon Rail company, building on a 2024 commercialization agreement and a May 2026 non-binding MOU. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed; this is an ordinary product-launch current report, not a special situation.
